data.long_meaning: Druthi is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'Druth' which means desire or longing. It is a name for a girl signifying strong inner desire and determination. This name is also associated with the goddess Lakshmi, symbolizing abundance and prosperity. The name Druthi carries the meaning “Desire, Longing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Druthi usually hope their child will grow to embody desire, longing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Druthi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Desire, Longing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Druthi total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
